study.question: Do the relative effects of the registered housing-access policy profiles remain defensible across evaluator-held-out structural model families?

changed_assumptions: Housing stock cannot expand except through explicit registered construction events.
Construction lead time is deterministic within a scenario.
Marginal capacity is capped by the declared physical stock and input budget.
descriptor.rationale: Simple known-truth development family for checking capacity and accounting invariants before adding adaptive supply behavior.

changed_assumptions: Construction events have a registered delay distribution.
Labor and material caps can bind concurrently.
Maintenance consumes the same finite input envelope as new construction.
descriptor.rationale: Development stress family to test whether the policy comparison captures lead time and input bottlenecks without relaxing the overall resource envelope.

analysis_plan.uncertainty_method: Register the hierarchical resampling unit and exact method after pilot variance diagnostics; retain model-family results separately and do not assume scenario probabilities.
